artworks.title: Freitag - Wiesenplan vor Aigen bey Salzburg (Meadow before Aigen near Salzburg)
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed landscape view from eye level. The horizon is high, showing distant hills and mountains. The style is fine line with cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia. Features include a monument with a cross, figures in agricultural activities, and trees leading to mountains in the distance.

artworks.title: Sonnabend - Gottesacker zu St. Peter in Salzburg (Saturday - Graveyard of St. Peter's in Salzburg)
artworks.description: The image shows a cemetery with a large stone building on the right-hand side and a winding pathway leading deeper into the scene. There is a high rock face enclosing the area, with a monastery structure built into it and distant trees in the background. Numerous gravestones and ornate crosses are scattered across the grass lawn. The artwork is detailed, with precise linework and shading, in sepia and gray tones.

artworks.title: Sonntag - Kircheneingang in Berchtesgaden (Sunday - Going to Church near Berchtesgaden)
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a village scene with a house on the right, a building that resembles a church on the left, and several figures in historical attire on a grassy path. The image features detailed textures and shading, with a monochromatic sepia color palette. In the distance, trees and hills can be seen in the pastoral landscape.

artworks.title: Tailpiece: Selig sind die nicht sehen und doch glauben (Blessed are those who do not
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed and intricate panel-like scene with symbolic figures and elements. The drawing depicts a central column or pedestal with an ornate statue at the center, flanked by two scenes on either side. The left side includes a man and woman seated in a pastoral setting with a dog, and another small panel with figures engaged in what appears to be a baptism. On the right side, figures are depicted in a rural setting with two individuals sitting under a tree. The backgrounds of these panels contain fields, trees, and symbols. The borders of the image are decorated with floral motifs and other intricate designs. The craftsmanship and attention to detail suggest themes of nature, spirituality, and human interaction. The central inscription is in German.

artworks.title: The Last Supper
artworks.artist: Jacob Cornelisz van Oostsanen after Albrecht Dürer
artworks.description: The image is a circular composition showing thirteen individuals seated around a rectangular banquet table. One individual is prominently positioned in the center with a radiant halo around their head. The individuals are depicted from a three-quarter to full view, with most of their upper bodies visible, wearing flowing robes. Some have curly or wavy hair, while others have beards and hair variations. There is a large serving platter with what appears to be a roasted animal in the center, surrounded by cups, plates, jugs, and utensils. The background includes an arched doorway and drapery above, creating depth in an enclosed space. The scene conveys symmetry and focus on the central figure, implying a gathering of historical or religious significance.

artworks.title: The Agony in the Garden
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene with sleeping figures and an angel. It features a central figure kneeling in prayer, surrounded by a rocky landscape, with several cloaked figures lying on the ground. A detailed depiction of an angel appears on a rocky outcrop, engaging with the kneeling figure. In the background, there are soldiers and natural elements like trees. The line work is intricate, with careful detailing that defines the folds in the clothing, the textures of the rocks, and the expressions or poses of the figures.

artworks.title: The Betrayal of Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures engaged in a tense moment. Some are armed and confronting each other in a chaotic scene. The central figures are surrounded by others with swords and spears. The background includes a tree and a building structure. The expressive detail, line work, and shading emphasize the intense emotions and actions of the figures.

artworks.title: Christ Led Away After His Arrest
artworks.description: This image depicts several figures in a circular composition engaged in a dynamic scene. The figures are elegantly dressed in period-style clothing and are shown in a chaotic struggle. Some hold torches and spears. The figures have intricate details, expressive facial expressions, and energetic poses. In the foreground, there are foliage and rocks, and a darker area in the bottom right. The style of the image is reminiscent of Renaissance era engravings.

artworks.title: The Mocking of Christ and Christ Before Caiaphas
artworks.description: This is a drawing illustrating a scene with multiple figures interacting in a circular composition. The image shows a confrontation, with several elaborately dressed figures in the foreground surrounding a central cloaked figure who is seated or kneeling. The central figure appears to be the focus, with others standing over or attending to them. The characters wear detailed historical or medieval-style clothing, with one holding a rod or staff and others wearing armor-like elements and hats. The background includes architectural features like arches and columns, adding depth to the scene. The artwork's intricate linework and shading suggest a narrative or allegorical context, full of movement and expression.

artworks.title: The Flagellation of Christ and Christ Before Pilate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a central figure tied to a column surrounded by people. The image depicts a scene where a semi-nude central figure is bound to a pillar and surrounded by several others who are in motion. The setting appears to be an indoor area with columns and an arch. The use of lines and shading creates depth and texture within the composition. The round framing adds a unique aspect to the illustration.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a gathering of figures around a central seated figure. The drawing features intricate line work and detailed rendering. The central figure is seated. Around this central character, several other figures are engaged in various activities. The setting appears to be an enclosed space with a wooden ceiling overhead. Some of the figures are positioned on a raised platform or stage-like area. The composition is circular, with balanced elements distributed throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene featuring individuals in intricate clothing gathered around a doorway or entrance, engaged in various activities. The scene is detailed with a focus on texture and style typical of the period. The figures are depicted in different positions and gestures, possibly involved in a discussion or event. The drawing is framed within an oval, highlighting the central activities. The lines and shading show craftsmanship and attention to artistic techniques in conveying depth and drama.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a circular scene depicting multiple figures engaged in action. The artwork features numerous individuals interacting in period-specific attire. Some figures hold weapons or tools. In the background, there is a landscape with rocky terrain and a tree. Strong lines and detailed cross-hatching are used to create depth and texture in the drawing.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a crucifixion scene. The image shows a central figure on a wooden cross surrounded by a crowd. The people are clad in robes and armor, with some carrying spears. The clothing and armor have ornate details. The scene is enclosed within a circular frame. The sky is depicted with distinct clouds.

artworks.title: The Lamentation and Entombment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a circular scene with several figures in a religious setting. The central figure is reclining, surrounded by others in robes and head coverings. In the background, two figures are on crosses with a ladder nearby. The figures are dressed in elaborate garments, and there are mountains and structures in the background. The drawing is detailed, capturing the scene with dramatic complexity.

artworks.title: The Resurrection and the Holy Women on Their Way to Christ's Sepulchre
artworks.description: The image depicts a central male figure standing, surrounded by various other figures. The central figure has long, wavy hair and a halo. The figures around him are soldiers or guards in armor and helmets. The central figure holds a staff with a cross-topped banner. The background shows rocky terrain, buildings, trees, and hills in a circular frame.

artworks.title: Goose Girl (Gardeuse d'oies)
artworks.description: This image shows a natural scene with a body of water in the foreground and geese swimming. To the left, a figure is seated under a large tree, apparently caring for the geese, while another tree is on the right. In the background, there are rolling hills and scattered trees. The scene is detailed using fine lines and hatching strokes to depict textures like trees and grass. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of brown, creating a calm and earthy tone.

artworks.title: Allégorie sur l'Erection de la Statue de Louis XV (Allegory on the Establishment of a Statue of Louis XV)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a classical architectural scene with statues and a central monument. The drawing includes a detailed central monument, flanked by tall pedestals on either side supporting statues. The scene is set in a classical architectural context with carvings and inscriptions visible on the bases of the statues. The surrounding elements include draped fabric and architectural features. In the background, there is a faint representation of clouds or celestial figures, creating depth and atmosphere. The line work and rendering of details show a meticulous approach to capturing the grandeur and elegance of classical forms.

artworks.title: Les chaises [lower half]
artworks.medium: etching, retouched with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing features a formal garden scene with an audience and performers. The image shows a gathering in an outdoor setting with a central statue on a pedestal, surrounded by large trees. Elegantly dressed figures are interacting, while others participate in a dance or performance. The scene appears to be from the 18th century, with intricate line work and detailed rendering of natural and human elements. The audience is engaged in the spectacle, creating an animated and lively atmosphere. The drawing depicts a moment of leisure and entertainment, emphasizing social interaction and cultural engagement of the period.

artworks.title: Le tonneau d'arrosage [upper half]
artworks.medium: etching, retouched with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a park or garden scene with a crowd of people. Trees fill the background with a canopy. The etching style features intricate lines and cross-hatching, depicting texture and depth. The figures are captured with gestural strokes. The color scheme is primarily sepia and dark brown. Closest to the observer, a group interacts around a large wheel. In the distance, a pedestal holds a statue with onlookers. The scene conveys a sense of activity and detail.

artworks.title: Vue du Salon du Louvre en l'année 1753 (View of the Salon in the Year 1753)
artworks.description: The image shows an art gallery with dozens of paintings hanging on the walls. The image illustrates a grand interior space with a staircase leading to a second level with more artwork displayed. The gallery has high ceilings and large windows. The drawing captures the details of the frames and the decor of the gallery, suggesting a busy and refined art-appreciation environment.

artworks.title: Banks of the Loing near Saint-Mammès (Bords du Loing, pres Saint-Mammès)
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a view from the riverbank looking across the water. The horizon is slightly above the center, where the water meets a line of tall trees. The trees create a dark backdrop against the pale sky. The brushstrokes are loose, conveying movement in the water and sky. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. Two figures walk by the river's edge with small boats nearby. In the distance, there is water and tall trees dominating the view. The style is impressionistic with minimal detail.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a monochrome drawing showing a chaotic scene with numerous dynamic figures in the central section. The background consists of rough lines suggesting a turbulent sky. The composition conveys a sense of drama, movement, tension, depth, and intensity.

artworks.title: Old Man and Woman
artworks.description: This is a monochromatic illustration featuring two individuals in a side-by-side arrangement. Their upper bodies dominate the frame, including heads, shoulders, and arms. The person on the left has deeply set eyes and pronounced facial features, while the other individual on the right appears to be wearing a headscarf. Both are depicted in loose-fitting garments, with the background primarily dark to create a dramatic effect.
